faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom Bottle-Opener Utility Metal Belt Buckles?
faqs.answer: The starting wholesale MOQ for Custom Bottle-Opener Utility Metal Belt Buckles is 50 pcs. Reference factory-direct tiered pricing is $5.60/pc (50 pcs starter tier), $3.85/pc (500 pcs tier), and $2.88/pc (2,000+ pcs volume tier), depending on size and finish complexity.

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom Bottle-Opener Utility Metal Belt Buckles, and when is it waived?

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom Bottle-Opener Utility Metal Belt Buckles?
faqs.answer: Custom Bottle-Opener Utility Metal Belt Buckles is custom-engineered from Reinforced 5.5mm Zinc Alloy using Heavy 3D Buckle with Reinforced Rear Cap Pry Lip, sized around 92×62×11mm at approximately 148g per unit (custom dimensions available).

faqs.question: Which electroplating colors and surface finishes are available for Custom Bottle-Opener Utility Metal Belt Buckles?
faqs.answer: Standard factory surface options for this custom craft include Antique Bronze / Gunmetal / Chrome. Dual-tone masking plating and custom matte or clear protective lacquer coatings are also available upon request.

faqs.answer: Yes. Send your vector logo (.AI, .EPS, .SVG, or vector .PDF) or rough sketch via our quote form or WhatsApp, and our engineering team will send a free 1:1 scaled digital production proof within 12 hours.

faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production physical samples take 7–10 business days (paid sample covers custom mold cutting to your design, plating, and enamel finishing; courier air freight is billed at carrier cost or via your DHL/FedEx account).

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom Bottle-Opener Utility Metal Belt Buckles?

faqs.question: What retail packaging upgrades are compatible with Custom Bottle-Opener Utility Metal Belt Buckles?
